limitations: Held-out observational prediction diagnostic. Query and reference differ in other chemistry; this does not validate a four-coordinate intervention or physical nonworsening. Historical folds already informed exploration.
Reference selected without query outcomes; design-time outcome screening in actual transfers is a different process.
Other 220 coordinates of a held-out query differ from its reference. Error is not an isolated four-coordinate intervention effect.
Maximum of three point predictions is not a confidence bound; its observed coverage is diagnostic only.
